name: CurseForge
tagline: Discover, install, and manage mods and modpacks
blurb: CurseForge is the home for game modding.
description:
CurseForge is the home for game modding. Browse and install mods, modpacks,
resource packs, worlds, and addons for Minecraft and other supported games,
and keep them up to date — all from one app.

Features:

• Browse and one-click install mods and modpacks

• Create, manage, and launch modded game profiles

• Automatic updates for your installed content

• Import and export modpacks to share with others

CurseForge is free to use, and every feature listed above works without paying.
The app shows ads. An optional paid subscription removes them and unlocks
cosmetic extras; it is not required for any of the functionality above.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
